% A REAL Beamer deck with five one-page frames and no notes -- the fixture for the probe's cheapest case
% (ADR-0048 §2.3): its labels read 1 2 3 4 5, so every page is a candidate first note page, and the probe must
% reject the last one by reading two pages' text, leaving the all-slides parse.
%
% beamer-plain.pdf was compiled from this file ONCE, on 2026-10-17, with
%   This is LuaHBTeX, Version 1.24.0 (TeX Live 2026/Arch Linux); beamer.cls 2026/01/22 v3.77
%   lualatex -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error beamer-plain.tex
% and is committed as-is: a frozen sample of real TeX output. Do not regenerate it to "fix" a test.
%
% Expected, written down before the first compile: 5 pages, labels 1 2 3 4 5, no note pages.
% Measured (2026-10-17): as expected.
\documentclass{beamer}
\title{Plain deck fixture}
\begin{document}
\begin{frame}{First}The first slide's words\end{frame}
\begin{frame}{Second}The second slide's words\end{frame}
\begin{frame}{Third}The third slide's words\end{frame}
\begin{frame}{Fourth}The fourth slide's words\end{frame}
\begin{frame}{Fifth}The fifth slide's words\end{frame}
\end{document}
